parent_objective: design preflight-only validation over M1485 calibrated neighbor-viability candidates
blocked_by: source preflight has not yet been designed for M1485 calibrated candidates
supersedes: proposal counts as geometry viability evidence

public_gates: M1486 must design source preflight only
M1486 must block replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run source preflight in this design milestone
do not treat proposal rows as geometry-pass evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs preflight-only validation over M1485 calibrated source-step candidates before any replay attempt
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: preflight design only; no preflight run, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design uses non-calibrated candidates
stop if design drops candidate_step_column source_step
stop if design admits replay or training before preflight result
stop if branch cadence requires synthesis before another narrow milestone
fallback_plan: route to preflight smoke if design passes
route to branch synthesis or audit if a guarded preflight command cannot be specified

admission_evidence: M1485 proposal smoke selected 112 candidates, including 88 neighbor-source rows across 5 seeds and 6 capability pairs with zero duplicate keys
blocked_shortcuts: do not run preflight in this design milestone
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1486 is design and makes no history-necessity claim.
history_necessity_tests: future replay must test calibrated neighbor-source rows under normal history, warmup interventions, reset hidden, and zero-current controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1485 neighbor viability calibration proposal smoke.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If preflight fails, audit geometry/calibration pressure rather than replaying unvalidated candidates.
allowed_claims: no preflight result, replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A source-step preflight-only design over M1485 calibrated candidates can validate geometry viability before another bounded replay attempt.
success_criteria: design blocks replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
design routes to preflight smoke or synthesis
failure_criteria: design starts replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1486 passes if it designs a source-step preflight-only smoke over M1485 calibrated candidates without running preflight or replay.
